title: NodeEventList
description: Response shape of GET /api/admin/nodes/{node_id}/events (docs/024 §5.2). Drives the live event tail in the /admin/activity nodes pane. Ordering matches the route: chronological when filtered to a conversation_id, latest-first otherwise.

node_id.description: Echoes the path parameter so the UI can hold one polling tail per node without re-parsing the request.

events.description: Zero or more events past the supplied after_seq. Empty array is a valid response — the node exists but has not emitted since.

id.description: Composite '{node_id}:{seq}'. Stable across the wire — used as a React key without re-deriving.

seq.description: Per-node monotonically increasing sequence from eidan.node_events (docs/024 §2.2).

payload.description: Emitter-supplied context. Shape varies by event type; treated as opaque JSON by the UI tail.

conversation_id.description: Soft FK into eidan.conversations.id when the event is turn-bound; null for node-level / scheduler events.
